help.title: Help
help.protection: With the kill switch enabled, VPN traffic cannot pass without a tunnel, including after Stop. Explicit direct-device rules remain direct.
help.connect_save: Paste your Hysteria 2 configuration and save.
help.connect_start: Open the server and press Connect.
help.test_note: Test validates the configuration format, not connectivity.
help.rules_direct: New rules use direct access. Select VPN when a tunnel is required.
help.rules_order: Device rules follow their saved order.
help.rules_dns: Use router DNS for domain rules. Encrypted DNS and shared website IPs limit matching.
help.rules_country: Country is determined by IP allocation, not website ownership.
help.vpn_measurement: A public HTTPS request through the tunnel. Missing measurements stay unavailable.
help.access_pin: Change PIN in App settings. The panel PIN is separate from the router password.
help.access_recovery: Forgot your PIN? Sign in to LuCI and open Change PIN.
help.access_clients: Incoming VPN clients use shared UDP/443 with separate keys. With client routing enabled they use the active VPN and country exceptions. LAN access is disabled by default and cannot be configured per client on a shared port.
help.access_client_port: The default port for Hysteria 2 and incoming VPN clients is UDP/443. Use 443 for the current setup. Importing a profile does not change the remote VPS port.
help.hiddify: Hiddify: import the hysteria2:// link from the clipboard. Connection refused on 127.0.0.1 while adding a profile indicates an unavailable local app component, not the router port. Fully restart Hiddify and retry; if it repeats, check the app version and logs.
